title: Bounded simulation of a machine run
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $x,y,w$ be finite Boolean words. Let $P$ be an input-head position for $y$, let $bits$ assign a Boolean value to each of the $nbits(M)$ positions, and let $\tau_O:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and $z_O\in\mathbb{Z}$. For every natural number $v$, configuration $c$ of $M$ on input $x$, state $q$ of $M$, and Boolean tag $b$ such that $ctrVal(w)=v$, the state of $c$ is $q$, and $b$ satisfies the boundary-tag condition for the input-head position of $c$, there are a natural number $s\le (v+1)(2|w|+3)$, a tape content function $\tau_C:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, an integer head position $z_C$, and a Boolean tag $b'$ such that $b'$ satisfies the boundary-tag condition for the input-head position of the configuration reached by $M$ from $c$ after $v$ steps. After $s$ steps, the tabulated machine started from the specified encoded configuration in its decode state reaches the specified encoded configuration in its write-decode state, carrying the machine's state and output register after those $v$ steps, its resulting configuration, and the tag $b'$, while using $\tau_C,z_C$ for the auxiliary tape and head and retaining $\tau_O,z_O$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a Turing machine with Boolean symbols and finite state set
x and y are Boolean words
bits assigns Boolean values to the nbits(M) positions
P is an input-head position for y
τO is an integer-indexed optional Boolean tape and zO is an integer
w is a Boolean word with ctrVal(w)=v
c is a configuration of M on input x and its state is q
q is a state of M
b satisfies the boundary-tag condition for c's input-head position
The simulation length s is at most (v+1)(2|w|+3)
τC is an integer-indexed optional Boolean tape, zC is an integer, and b' is a Boolean tag
b' satisfies the boundary-tag condition for the input-head position after v steps
caveat: The endpoint is defined through the encoded-configuration construction; the prose summarizes the fields of those configurations.
